verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents scripted avatar videos, including avatars made from a single photo, and lets users upload their own script audio for Video API videos. Its explicit lip-sync claims, however, appear only in the dubbing and translation context, so lip movement matched to a creator's own dialogue on generated avatars is implied rather than stated. missing for 10: explicit documentation that avatar lip movement is synced to user-supplied script text or audio, independent or hands-on corroboration of lip-sync quality for generated characters.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
